highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with upstream correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback can select a different face after this update; applications requiring deterministic text output should use explicit or bundled typefaces.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the earlier FcFontSort path, which can change fallback glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family and style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates subsequent upstream correctness, buffer-upload, and servicing fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and upstream servicing fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 prepared the m153 line for final validation.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp packaging was updated to keep native compiler-warning suppression scoped to the affected code.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: The preview includes upstream renderer servicing fixes and notes a Linux font fallback behavior change.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the m153 update for final validation.
